name: Article 25, § 3 – 351
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text: 3. The ERCC shall facilitate the exchange of operational information and the delivery of assistance requested under Article 28. Its activities shall support the competent national authorities and shall not replace national command structures. The ERCC shall have no power to issue binding operational instructions to Member States or their personnel.
